subject: general
question: As on March 2022, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Account holder gets an accidental insurance cover of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** As of March 2022, Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Account holders were entitled to an accidental insurance cover ranging from ₹1 lakh to ₹2 lakh .**
 
• The** PMJDY scheme provides **free accidental insurance coverage to all account holders.
 
• This **cover is designed to provide financial support** to the family of the account holder in the event of an accidental death or permanent total disability.
 
• The accidental insurance coverage is linked to the RuPay debit card issued to PMJDY account holders.
 
• The card must be used for at least one transaction (financial or non-financial) in the preceding 90 days to be eligible for the insurance.
 
• The coverage amount varies depending on the type of PMJDY account and the premium paid. 
 
• While the basic coverage was ₹1 lakh, some account holders may have been eligible for higher coverage amounts.
